name: Rick Rock
sources: Hip-Hop and Politics — Rick Rock interview — https://hiphopandpolitics.com/2006/04/03/rick-rock-the-federation-going-beyond-hyphy/
notes: The one entry in this batch whose harmony is defined by what it refuses. His stated aesthetic is novelty over convention — "you have to keep putting paint where it ain't" — and the research turns that into an instruction to avoid the stock `i–VI–VII`. So that family is absent here on purpose, the weight goes to `i–v` and `i–III` motion instead, and `borrowed.V` is raised to 0.3 for the chromatic colour. "Slaps" means drums and bass are the design target, and rock-informed means dynamics: `velocityTiers` has the widest accent-to-ghost spread in the batch, ghost notes on the snare are nearly off because the snare is huge and compressed, and the bass is percussive rather than melodic — `mirror_kick` at 0.88 with almost no glide, the opposite of every 90s entry here. Short, odd, hooky synth motifs with big register gaps is a low `densityPerBar` against a high `leap` share and the highest `octaveJumpProb` on this axis. Full drops for radio impact is `dropOutBeats.prob` 0.85. ⚠ `hihat.continuous` is false for the research's "sparser hats", with `fillDensity` held at 0.3 so every seed still gets hats. ⚠ `medium` is the research's own rating: the aesthetic statements are quoted, the tempo band and every specific number below are read from the catalogue. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 979 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [2,1,4], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
